title: Bind a route number
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Bind a route number. Try /double/cat.
introduction: FromRoute reads a path value. Open GET /double/4. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Bind a route number with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Bind a route number

blocks.text: FromRoute reads the constrained n value. The method doubles the resulting 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A route constraint controls matching; it is not a full data validation policy.
